maddeler.e:
أستفحل (form X)
# أَسْتَفْحِلُ (ʔastafḥilu) /ʔas.taf.ħi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
# أَسْتَفْحِلَ (ʔastafḥila) /ʔas.taf.ħi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
# أَسْتَفْحِلْ (ʔastafḥil) /ʔas.taf.ħil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
